notes: Per-PC settings for test-console\desk.ps1, the one command over both repositories' Docker launchers (privateAI-design-31 s5). Copy to config/local/desk.json (git-ignored). secretsDir holds near-testnet.env, near-watch.env, paid-jobs.env, chainaim.env (only checked to exist; never read by desk.ps1). adminUi.watch / gasPerPaymentNear go to the adminUI's nearadminup.ps1 (-Watch / -GasPerPaymentNear); without them it uses its committed config/near-watch-watch.conf. Prices are not here: test-console/up.ps1 reads config/paid-jobs-prices.conf or <secretsDir>/paid-jobs-settings.env. The adminUI checkout comes from config/local/repos.json (nearWatchDir).
